content.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Complaints that free listening is constrained by ads and limits on choosing, skipping, or playing songs in a preferred order, making the app frustrating to use.","issue_id":"ISSUE-USABILITY","name":"Listening controls and free-tier restrictions"},{"description":"Reports of the app showing a black screen, shutting down during playback, or falsely reporting no internet connection while playing music.","issue_id":"ISSUE-PLAYBACK","name":"Playback and app stability"},{"description":"Complaints about premium requirements, subscription access problems, and features or listening options being moved behind a paid plan.","issue_id":"ISSUE-BILLING","name":"Premium access and subscription concerns"},{"description":"General negative reactions to the app or an update without a specific problem described.","issue_id":"ISSUE-OTHER","name":"General dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Complaints about unavailable songs, limited previews, or trouble accessing Spotify Wrapped.","issue_id":"ISSUE-CATALOG","name":"Music catalog and content availability"},{"description":"Reports of being unable to log in or access an account, including errors that persist despite working internet access elsewhere.","issue_id":"ISSUE-ACCESS","name":"Account login and access problems"},{"description":"Problems with offline listening, downloads, storage changes, lost playlists, and related app integrations or settings.","issue_id":"ISSUE-DOWNLOADS","name":"Offline listening and saved music"},{"description":"Negative feedback about Spotify customer support or its perceived stance on social issues.","issue_id":"ISSUE-SUPPORT","name":"Support and company stance"}]}
